title: Batterie und Laden, the new Macan 4 and Macan Turbo (Porsche newsroom press kit)
notes: Gross 100 kWh, about 95 kWh usable; NMC 8:1:1; 800 V; up to 270 kW (135 kW at 400 V); 10-80% about 21 min; AC up to 11 kW; "The battery is preconditioned for an optimal charging experience", Charging Planner can precondition via route planning.
